newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes higher on export demand ideas.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes higher on export demand ideas.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended higher on Wednesday, boosted by ideas of increased world demand for U.S. rice, traders said.
"Potential business underpinned the market," a floor trader said. He was referring to a Costa Rican tender for rice that could include U.S. supplies.
But trade sources said the May and July contracts were nearing a strong resistance point and may have trouble rallying beyond that point.
"We're getting closer to this $11.80-$11.85 point," a floor source said. "We should hit big resistance there."
Rice ended seven to two cents per cwt higher with May up four at $11.75.
Rice volume was estimated by CBOT at 350 lots, compared with Tuesday's actual volume of 581 lots.
